<Preview>
  <goa-modal heading="Submit assessment" open="true">
    Submitting the assessment will inform the proponent and email a copy of the report.
    <goa-button-group alignment="end" slot="actions">
      <goa-button type="secondary">Cancel</goa-button>
      <goa-button type="primary">Submit</goa-button>
    </goa-button-group>
  </goa-modal>
</Preview>
description: Use a concise and descriptive modal title that spans less than one line.
